_read_me: Approximate PM-JAY / CGHS national package rates, for the subset of treatments where a public secondary source gives a figure. PM-JAY/CGHS rates are the same across all states/UTs, so one 'govt' entry per treatment correctly serves every state. These are rounded approximations gathered from secondary aggregators referencing the NHA Health Benefit Package schedule and CGHS rate lists, NOT the primary nha.gov.in / cghs.gov.in PDFs — verify the exact current figure before relying on it. The seed loader flattens this file into national_references rows.
